# Inversion Tactics

## Overview
The parasitic takeover of the physical plane of existence was not an instantaneous conquest, but a meticulously planned and systematically executed multidimensional inversion. Originating from the betrayal of the Custodians, this takeover involved the deliberate suppression of the central realm of Gateway-10 from its original highly vibrational state into an inverted, biologically engineered prison matrix. The inversion tactics deployed were absolute and comprehensive, encompassing the destruction of primary energetic architecture, the implementation of Density Suppression technology, and the complete rewriting of physical laws, historical narratives, and biological realities to subjugate Taran souls within a closed 3rd density loop.

## Key Terminology

- **Custodians** — Originally highly benevolent, 12th density caretakers of the realms who succumbed to negativity and orchestrated the entire parasitic inversion over millennia, subsequently creating all other negative species.

- **Gateway-10** — The central hub comprising 178 physical worlds; its center, previously known as Realm-2 and now as the "known lands," is the most powerful point on the planetary toroid field.

- **Density Suppression** — Advanced parasitic technology functioning like a "dimmer switch" to artificially lower the vibratory state of the realm from 9th to 3rd density, rendering higher-density positive architecture invisible and allowing lower-frequency entities to exist.

- **Spirit Tree (Mt Meru)** — The central energetic node of the realm at Hyperborea (the North Pole), destroyed by parasites to severely limit the natural power of Gateway-10.

- **Overlays** — Projected frequencies and holographic illusions used to obscure unmovable high-density architecture, project false celestial bodies, and alter the visual perception of matter within the 3rd density simulation.

- **Black Void Plasma** — Niberian technology utilized within the firmament to create the illusion that space is black, concealing the true nature of the cosmos, which consists of bright white light.

## Core Revelations
The genesis of all negativity in the universe traces directly to the Custodians, who plotted their betrayal long before their own vibrational density degraded. Recognizing that their eventual descent into overt negativity would strip them of their higher manifestation abilities, they pre-emptively designed a comprehensive control matrix. They biologically engineered subordinate 4th density surrogate species—including the Anuk (Anunnaki), Omicron, Alpha Draco, Niberians, and Greys—to physically enforce the occupation over the 3rd density human population they intended to subjugate.

The physical commencement of the parasitic takeover mirrored a SWAT team cutting power to a building. The Grey ET factions actively destroyed the Spirit Tree at Mt Meru, replacing it with a petrified stump. This catastrophic act instantly severed the primary energy supply across the entire Gateway-10 system, preventing indigenous species from mounting a defense and plunging the realm's operational frequency low enough for the 14-foot tall, low-vibrational parasitic entities to physically manifest on the land without becoming violently ill.

## Detailed Mechanics and Key Elements

- **Architectural and Density Inversion:** To completely erase the original 9th density reality, the parasites employed Density Suppression to phase out the highly advanced crystalline temples and cities. Once the visual and physical density was lowered to 3rd, the parasites commanded Freemasons and sold souls to construct negative, block-work edifices (such as concrete and masonry) precisely on the physical footprints of the original temples. This covered up the positive energy points. Additionally, high-frequency Nodal points were intentionally capped with stone "Alters" to explicitly dampen their natural electromagnetic emissions.

- **Technological Regression:** The takeover required downgrading humanity from a civilization of absolute energetic mastery to one reliant on primitive, parasitic mechanics. The highly advanced Tartarian atmospheric condensers and induction technology, which harvested free electromagnetic energy directly from the Lattice Membrane Network (Ley Lines), were systematically destroyed, smelted, and replaced by the forced reliance on mined coal, oil, and combustion engines. The fundamental concept of the "Wheel" was introduced by parasites as a control mechanism; true ET and higher-density beings do not utilize wheels or crude mechanical conveyances.

- **Linguistic and Conceptual Reprogramming:** To solidify the prison matrix, the conceptual understanding of reality was completely inverted. The word for "Soul" was aggressively altered to "Sol," tricking humans into believing in a vast external "Solar System" rather than an internal cosmic family. The fabricated theory of Evolution was introduced to conceal the reality of intelligent laboratory genetics, convincing humans they ascended from monkeys rather than acknowledging the deliberate genetic termination of robust hominids in favor of the fragile, easily exploitable Homo Sapiens.

## Broader Context and Interconnections

- **The Mutilation of the Biosphere:** The inversion tactics extend beyond environmental suppression directly into the biological corruption of the human vessel. The parasites introduced heavy metals (nickel, lead, chromium) and artificial endocrine disruptors via systems like the promoted "Vaping" industry to specifically target and calcify the Pineal Gland. This biological inversion stunts spiritual reception, blocks higher chakra frequencies, and forces the etheric body to remain susceptible to AI behavioral nudges. The global food supply was similarly inverted, completely replacing authentic biological meat with synthetic, lab-grown vat meat distributed through major corporate supermarkets since the 1960s.

- **Energetic Harvesting Networks:** The physical infrastructure of modern society was explicitly mapped to invert natural energy flows. Villages, towns, and cities were purposefully established directly over positive nodes, so the dense, controlled populations would naturally suppress the positive energy and simultaneously generate negative Loosh. This energy is siphoned utilizing modern infrastructure, including roads, train tracks, and Baphomet Power Pylons, which not only deliver electricity but covertly harvest the backed-up Ley-Line energy from the perimeters of densely populated areas.

- **Holographic Concealment:** To prevent humans from observing the actual parameters of their enclosure, a massive Projection Dome was installed inside the true firmament. This dome visually generates fake celestial bodies like asteroids (which are actual parasitic biological weapons when portal-dropped) and the illusion of a deep, dark space. Additionally, localized Overlays are projected over indestructible high-frequency sites, such as the Emerald Palace at the North Pole, utilizing fields of stolen gold idols and ULF (Ultra Low Frequency) blankets to completely mask these sanctuaries from 3rd density perception.

## Strategic Implications

- **The Goal of the 8th Re-set:** The ultimate strategic objective of the entire parasitic inversion was the execution of the 8th Re-set, originally slated for 2019. This event was engineered to definitively lock an artificially reduced population of 500 million (as dictated by the Georgia Guidestones) into an eternal, inescapable loop of birth, rape, torture, and sacrifice. Had this succeeded, Gateway-10 would have completely fallen, signaling the ultimate victory of evil over physical creation and necessitating the total destruction of the multi-billion-year physical experiment.

- **The Imminent Collapse of the Overlays:** Because the Galactic Ancestral Alliance (G.A.A) has terminated the parasitic control, the inversion tactics are currently unwinding. During the impending Fake Alien Invasion and Emergency Broadcast System (EBS) events, the G.A.A will actively deactivate the Projection Dome and strip away the parasitic Overlays. The 3rd density environment will instantly display severe pixelation and bleed-through scaffolding as the illusions melt away. Following the global 30-second EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequency) flash, the 97% of the population engineered as NPCs will evaporate, collapsing the inverted matrix entirely and liberating the original souls back into higher-density truth.
